title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer circuit-breaker backoff & regional failover thrashing
author: Jordan Lee
description: Summary: This hotfix addresses a production stability issue where the SLO enforcer's circuit-breaker backoff and regional failover logic could thrash under load, causing cascading regional failovers and unnecessary load-shedding. Root cause: a race in circuit-breaker state transitions combined with aggressive immediate failover triggers. The race allowed multiple concurrent backoff timers to reset or overwrite each other resulting in premature/duplicate failovers and amplified traffic shifts across regions. Fixes: 1) Make CB state transitions atomic by switching to a compare-and-swap (CAS) update on the control-store (etcd) value used by the enforcer; this prevents concurrent timers from stomp-ing each other. 2) Introduce a per-region smoothing window for SLO violations (configurable default 30s) to debounce transient spikes before triggering failover. 3) Add a rate-limited failover guard (max 1 failover/region per configured interval) to prevent thrashing. 4) Centralize and tag metrics emitted by the enforcer so we can accurately track state transitions, backoff resets, and decision reasons. 5) Add unit tests for CAS transitions and an integration e2e test that simulates overlapping timer callbacks. 6) Update defaults: smoothing_window = 30s (was 3s), max_failovers_per_window = 1. Rollout plan: immediate squash-merge to main, enable by default for hosted clusters, monitor the next 72 hours with a dashboard and alert tuned for "enforcer.failover.rate" and "enforcer.cb.reset_count". If regressions observed, we will toggle the feature-flag `slo_enforcer_smoothing` and roll back. Related incidents: production incident on 2026-02-24 (SUP-1182).

review_comments: Ava Chen: Can you add a short note in the runbook about how to toggle the feature-flag and expected metric signals?
Jordan Lee: Added runbook section + feature-flag instructions in docs/operational/runbooks/slo-enforcer.md
Ravi Patel: The CAS approach looks good — did you consider using a distributed lock to simplify semantics?
Jordan Lee: We considered locks but CAS keeps the path lock-free and avoids cross-process lock coordination during high QPS; added comments and a benchmark that shows minimal overhead.
Maya Singh: Please ensure the e2e test runs in CI. It should be marked flaky=false and be fast (<10s).
Jordan Lee: e2e test is in the CI matrix under fast-integration and completes in ~4s on our runner; added retries for transient etcd delays.
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer circuit-breaker backoff and regional failover. Addresses a race condition that could cause failover thrashing. Default smoothing_window increased to 30s; adds rate-limited failover guard and atomic CB state updates.
post_deploy_monitoring: Watch enforcer.failover.rate, enforcer.cb.reset_count, region.request_shift_percent. Deployment rolled out to hosted clusters; ops to monitor alerts for 72h.
